stories.author: Judd Legum
stories.title: Trump’s 9/11 fantasies
stories.text: Trump is marking the occasion by describing his role in heroic terms, claiming he personally went to Ground Zero to aid recovery efforts. On September 6, Trump made the following remarks on Fox News: And I went down. I was building a building in New York, and I had a lot of construction workers. And I went down there very shortly thereafter the following day, you couldn’t go down the same day, but like the following day, very, very quickly afterwards and we worked long and hard . Trump relayed a similar story at a White House event on Tuesday: I was building a big building in New York and I took the whole crew down there right after this happened , and they had no hesitation. Everybody went down with me. We went down as a big group of people. Wasn’t too much we could do, I’ll be honest. It was — it was raw. Nobody’s seen anything like it ever. Although some details change, Trump has made similar claims in interviews for decades, claiming to have sent 100 or more construction workers to Ground Zero. stories.title: U.S. Finds A War It’s Willing to Declare
stories.text: Official seal of DHS — until now Fundraising fell off a cliff this summer. Not accepting a dime in corporate ad money allows me to be genuinely independent; but it also means I’m ENTIRELY dependent on readers like you to survive. Where the ubiquitous American eagle faced the direction of the olive branches in its right talon, now the eagle will face the opposite direction — towards the arrows it clasps in its other talon. “We’re actually changing our seal to make it look towards the arrows because … when it looks towards the arrows is when it means we’re at war,” Secretary Markwayne Mullin revealed in a Fox News interview this weekend. “Homeland Security is at war every single day against bad actors trying to hurt our backyards, and we’re not gonna allow that to happen.” So in other words, the United States is at war here at home — but Iran somehow isn’t a war. What? On October 25, 1945—seven and a half weeks after Japan’s formal surrender—President Harry S. Truman issued Executive Order 9646, formally defining the presidential coat of arms, seal, and flag. stories.title: Trump's Fed Chief Missed The AI-flation Memo
stories.text: Trump’s new head of monetary policy, Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh, recently announced the U.S. central bank doesn’t yet know how artificial intelligence will impact the economy, but he believes it “will leave us much better prepared for tomorrow.” Warsh, a politically slippery former banking executive who’s downplayed AI’s inflationary impacts before, might not be reading his bank’s own policy papers: In March, Federal Reserve economists warned that the AI data center boom currently fueling higher utility costs could further eat into consumers’ pocketbooks by driving up overall inflation.
